hints.title: Consecutive Horizontal Ones
hints.text: Precalculate the number of consecutive ones to the left of each cell, including the cell itself.

hints.title: Vertical Bounding
hints.text: For each cell (r, c), iterate upward through rows k from r down to 0, maintaining the minimum horizontal width encountered so far.

hints.title: Add Bounded Widths
hints.text: Each upward row k contributes its accumulated minimum width to the total count of all-one submatrices with bottom-right corner at (r, c).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(R^2 * C^2) possible submatrix bounding boxes takes O(R^3 * C^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Compressing each row to horizontal consecutive counts reduces the check to O(R^2 * C).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate aggregates submatrix count by fixing the bottom-right corner and accumulating running minimum widths.
complexity.notes: Can also be optimized to O(R * C) using a monotonic stack per row.
